comments.author: @JanKowalski-hc2wl
comments.text: The cover imagery featuring local women paired with the title 'EVERYTHING IS CHEAP' is a highly manipulative tactic that invokes the demeaning language of adult tourism. It reduces the dignity of Sarajevo’s women to mere commodities for clicks.Furthermore, the historical errors damage the credibility of the entire content.  Stating that the siege started in 1992 and lasted until 'February 1990' is an impossible chronological smack on readers' intelligence (19:51). For the record, the Siege of Sarajevo officially ended on February 29, 1996 . Coupling discussions of intense post-war national conflict and political tension with relaxed, chillout background music is a massive editorial failure . It completely misrepresents the ground reality: Bosna is a peaceful country, yet it remains full of high internal tension .Even your terminology ignores the people who live here (29:45). Natives call both the country and the river 'Bosna' . Twisting the spelling and pronunciation to 'Bosnia' in English is a form of soft linguistic colonialism that forces local identity into Western expectations. You cannot claim to honor a city that survived a historic tragedy while using exploitative tropes and distorted names to generate revenue  Fix your basic history and respect the population
